feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence: iteration 6 (wheel_track 0.09 m, controller unchanged) scored 372.2, the best so far. The oval held at 17/20 with max_error 0.044 m and oscillation 0.30. s-bend stayed at 0/20 with line-loss 1.3 and max_error 0.064 m, and slalom at 0/20 with line-loss 1.9. Narrowing has reached its floor and gave only small gains (iterations 5 and 6). Span (iteration 2) and footprint (iteration 3) both hurt, and forward position (iteration 4) helped only the oval. The controller has not needed any change beyond the settings held since iteration 4, so I have no controller-side evidence to report for this body. Decision rules for the next race: (a) If s-bend line-loss falls to 1.0 or below with max_error under 0.06 m and the oval holds at 16/20 or better, keep mass 0.5 kg. (b) If s-bend line-loss stays above 1.0 with the oval holding, mass is not the lever and the remaining gap is the controller's response on sharp bends; do not go narrower or change span, footprint or y. (c) If the oval falls below about 14/20 or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35 with low max_error, return mass to 0.7 kg, since a lighter robot is then jittery.
requested_changes: Keep mass 0.5 kg only if s-bend line-loss falls to 1.0 or below with max_error under 0.06 m and the oval holds at 16/20 or better. Evidence: iteration 6 is the best-known body (372.2), and mass is the one body lever not yet tested cleanly, since iteration 0 to 1 confounded it with wheel_track and sensors.

If the oval falls below about 14/20 or steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 with low max_error at 0.5 kg, return mass to 0.7 kg. Evidence: the oval oscillation was 0.30 at 0.7 kg in iteration 6, so a rise would show the lighter robot is jittery.

If s-bend stays at about 1.3 line-loss with max_error near 0.06 m at 0.5 kg, stop geometry tests on the sharp tracks. Keep wheel_track 0.09 m (do not go narrower), span ±0.03 m, y 0.07 m, footprint 0.012 m and wheel_radius 0.03 m, and let the Integrator change the controller response instead. Evidence: span, footprint and forward-position tests (iterations 2 to 4) and narrowing to 0.09 m (iteration 6) have not moved s-bend line-loss below 1.3.
